The US and Canada are working on a [USN:L2N46C11U TEXT:"deal"] to ease US tariffs on Canadian steel and autos, two US and four Canadian sources have said. The price of [USN:L2N46D00J TEXT:"oil"], one of Canada's major exports, fell as traders focused on Middle East peace talks. US crude oil futures settled 1.8% lower at $99.90 a barrel. Canadian bond yields edged lower across the curve. The 2-year was down by nearly one basis point at 3.367%, while it fell 3.1 basis points further below the equivalent US rate to a gap of about 137 basis points in favor of the US note.

item.title: Setor de renováveis do Brasil busca retomada em 2027 com continuidade do governo Lula
item.description: O setor de energias renováveis do Brasil, que enfrenta grave crise, espera que o quarto mandato de Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva ajude a promover a retomada de seus investimentos para 2027, com a implementação pelo governo de importantes medidas que vinham sendo estudadas e maturadas nos últimos quatro anos, disseram executivos e representantes do setor nesta terça-feira.
item.dc:creator: Leticia Augusto
item.content:encoded: O setor de energias renováveis do Brasil, que enfrenta grave crise, espera que o quarto mandato de Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva ajude a promover a retomada de seus investimentos para 2027, com a implementação pelo governo de importantes medidas que vinham sendo estudadas e maturadas nos últimos quatro anos, disseram executivos e representantes do setor nesta terça-feira. Entre os desafios a serem superados, o setor destaca a redução dos cortes de geração renovável, principalmente através da integração de novas tecnologias e ampliação das redes elétricas, e estímulos para um crescimento mais forte da demanda por energia, como a atração de projetos de data centers e de indústria "verde". "O governo Lula ficou um bom tempo estudando, diagnosticando, propondo e fazendo planos, mas não houve tempo de implementação, principalmente da lógica de nova indústria brasileira. Então, é nesse contexto que nós entendemos que haverá implementação (no próximo mandato)", disse Elbia Gannoum, presidente da associação ABEEólica, durante o evento Brazil Wind Power. A ABEEólica ainda prevê uma [USN:L1N3X20RW TEXT:"queda das instalações"] de parques eólicos em 2026, mas comemora os novos investimentos anunciados ao longo deste ano por geradoras como [USN:L1N41V0O1 TEXT:"Casa dos Ventos"] e a norueguesa [USN:L6N43A0P2 TEXT:"Statkraft"]. Segundo Gannoum, esses aportes já se refletem agora "no chão de fábrica" da cadeia eólica, e vão se concretizar em adição de nova oferta da fonte a partir de meados de 2027. "Ano que vem e em 2028 a gente já vê uma indústria (eólica) em curva crescente", disse ela, acrescentando que a "nova indústria brasileira" poderá viabilizar, a partir de 2030, adição de oferta eólica na casa de 6 a 7 gigawatts por ano. POLÍTICA PARA DATA CENTERS O setor de energias renováveis, frequentemente citado por Lula como um trunfo da economia brasileira em seus discursos, foi relembrado pelo presidente no domingo. Na primeira fala após sua reeleição, Lula associou as renováveis à indústria de data centers, ressaltando o potencial do Brasil para alimentar o consumo de energia desses projetos a partir de fontes limpas. André Salgado, CEO da francesa EDF Power Solutions, destacou que os data centers serão um propulsor importante de demanda para novos projetos de energias renováveis no Brasil, mas que o país precisará melhorar o planejamento para acomodar essas grandes cargas na rede elétrica nacional. "Não adianta continuar instalando tudo no Sudeste, do lado de São Paulo (principal eixo de data centers), quando a nossa geração de energia está no Nordeste e no Norte", afirmou ele, no evento. CORTES DE GERAÇÃO RENOVÁVEL Outro tema recorrentemente citado entre os desafios para o próximo governo são os cortes da geração renovável, ou "curtailments", que ocorrem quando a rede elétrica atinge seus limites operacionais. O problema se tornou uma das principais preocupações do setor elétrico brasileiro, já que vem resultando em prejuízos bilionários aos geradores e em desperdício de energia limpa. Vários grandes geradores de energia interromperam novos investimentos em renováveis no país e condicionam sua retomada ao avanço de soluções para a questão. Embora o Brasil já tenha definido ressarcimentos retroativos para parte dos cortes, ainda há incertezas regulatórias, e as empresas querem rediscutir a classificação das restrições, especialmente as ligadas à sobreoferta de energia no sistema. Para Karin Luchesi, CEO da Elera, geradora renovável da Brookfield (BAM.N) , a continuidade do governo, com um novo mandato de Lula, "não é ruim". "A gente já viu em discussões tanto com o governo, quanto Aneel, ministério, ONS e o próprio Congresso, uma evolução do tema do curtailment." Segundo a executiva, o problema dos cortes de geração precisa ser endereçado no momento atual, com soluções de ordem técnica, para produzir efeitos no médio prazo. "É insustentável a gente cortar 20%, 30% da geração renovável. Não faz sentido do ponto de vista econômico." Os cortes de geração renovável estão aumentando mundialmente, diante do crescimento das energias eólica e solar como alternativa às fontes fósseis. O "curtailment" é um dos fatores por trás da [USN:L6N46D0OP TEXT:"desaceleração esperada para a capacidade de energia limpa em 2026"], segundo a Agência Internacional de Energia Renovável (Irena).

item.title: Mercedes spent millions on nurturing Antonelli after Ferrari said no
item.description: Ferrari fans can only imagine what might have been had local boy Kimi Antonelli signed for their team rather than Mercedes as a young go-karter.
item.dc:creator: Alan Baldwin
item.content:encoded: Ferrari fans can only imagine what might have been had local boy Kimi Antonelli signed for their team rather than Mercedes as a young go-karter. Formula One's oldest and most successful team had the chance to secure the talent now [USN:L6N46B095 TEXT:"set to become Italy's first champion in 73 years"], and Formula One's youngest ever, but let it slip through their fingers. Mercedes seized the opportunity instead in 2018, when Antonelli was 11. "For Ferrari, Kimi was still too young whereas Mercedes could offer better guarantees regarding his future prospects," Antonelli's former manager Giovanni Minardi told the Gazzetta dello Sport newspaper earlier this year. Former Ferrari president Luca di Montezemolo, who was no longer involved with the team at that point, saw a silver lining. "I am a Ferrari man but I'm delighted to see what Antonelli is doing," he told Spanish newspaper AS last month. "What I do regret is that Ferrari had the chance to sign him. They didn't. "A great opportunity vanished, but almost better for Antonelli. Such a young Italian driving a Ferrari... It would have been terrible pressure." Mercedes team boss and co-owner Toto Wolff credited Gwen Lagrue, who is [USN:L6N43T0TM TEXT:"joining Red Bull next year"] to run their young driver programme, for bringing Antonelli, now 20, on board. He said also that people did not appreciate the amount of work that has gone into nurturing the team's successor to seven-time world champion Lewis Hamilton. "I read an interview with Piero Ferrari last week where he said, 'What a talent. He reminds me of Niki Lauda'. And I'm thinking, 'People don't get that this is the work of nine years'," the Austrian told reporters after Antonelli won last Sunday's US Grand Prix in Austin, his ninth win of the season. "The development of nine years, the hardship of nine years, the integration of the team, the working with the engineers, the 10 or more millions spent in the development of his career, of his ability, of his character together with his parents. "It's just not that it landed like this." Wolff recalled how others said Antonelli, after nine rounds without points last year, should not have been given the Mercedes seat. He spoke of those at other teams who suggested the youngster should not even be in Formula One. "All of that now is extremely satisfying, to see what he's able to deliver and how he's working with the team, with (race engineer Peter) Bono (Bonnington) and yielding the results. But it wasn't an easy road."

item.title: Hacking attempts against US Federal Election Commission system triggered outage, email shows
item.description: The US Federal Election Commission's website has been targeted by a hacker or hackers, disrupting the agency's electronic filings system a week before the November 3 elections, according to an email seen by Reuters.
item.dc:creator: Dawn Kopecki
item.content:encoded: The US Federal Election Commission's website has been targeted by a hacker or hackers, disrupting the agency's electronic filings system a week before the November 3 elections, according to an email seen by Reuters. In a statement, the FEC said that, "at this time, the FEC’s electronic filing system is currently offline and our IT staff are actively working to restore service." The FEC, which tracks the spending of candidates and political committees, said that users could still search the website for past reports. It declined further comment on the outage. The hacking attempts come a week before the [TOPIC:"reuters:/world/us/elections/" TEXT:"midterm elections"], which will determine whether President Donald Trump's Republicans maintain their majorities in Congress for the next two years. The FEC does not play a role in administering US elections and the outage should have no effect on voters' ability to cast ballots. The outage prevents organizations from filing the FEC's 24-hour and 48-hour spending reports, which show how much political groups and others are spending on specific races. "I've never seen this in 26 years," said Steven Mele, a partner at political finance compliance firm MBA Consulting Group. "The result is there will be less disclosure on the elections" until it's fixed. A status message posted by the FEC noted that its filing system had been down since around 10 p.m. ET on Monday (0200 GMT Tuesday). The Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency and the FBI did not immediately return messages seeking comment.

item.title: French minister: talks progressing over Germany buying 50% stake in KNDS from German owner families
item.description: French defence minister Catherine Vautrin said on Tuesday that talks were moving ahead regarding plans by the German government to buy a 50% stake in Franco-German tank maker KNDS from its German owner families.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: French defence minister Catherine Vautrin said on Tuesday that talks were moving ahead regarding plans by the German government to buy a 50% stake in [USN:L8N4601KT TEXT:"Franco-German tank maker KNDS"] from its German owner families. "I believe that talks are progressing with a view towards a purchase by the German government," Vautrin told a parliamentary hearing. KNDS CEO Jean-Paul Alary told Reuters on October 19 that he would [USN:L8N4650ZZ TEXT:"prefer an initial public offering"]as soon as market conditions allow, adding he welcomed the German government taking a stake in the company.

item.title: Food and household brands warn of more price hikes as Iran war costs bite
item.description: The world's top consumer goods and food companies, from Coca-Cola and Procter & Gamble to Nestle and Reckitt, have warned of further price hikes next year to cover rising costs even as shoppers remain reluctant to splurge on groceries.
item.dc:creator: Alexander Marrow, Anuja Mistry
item.content:encoded: The world's top consumer goods and food companies, from Coca-Cola and Procter & Gamble to Nestle and Reckitt, have warned of further price hikes next year to cover rising costs even as shoppers remain reluctant to splurge on groceries. Higher energy, raw material and freight costs as a result of the US war on Iran mean that the companies making everything from laundry detergent to soda and snacks face a balancing act to protect profit margins. Even higher prices on everyday items will fuel concerns that inflation will persist into next year. High gas and grocery bills are a big factor in next week's US midterm elections . Soaring costs related to the war are the latest headache for consumer goods, food and drink companies, which have struggled with lacklustre sales since the pandemic, as shoppers have baulked at increasingly expensive name-brand packaged food. Last year, they had to contend with tariffs on imported goods imposed by US President Donald Trump. "Pricing is the last lever these companies have left, and they’re pulling it into a consumer who’s already tapped out on paying more," said David Wagner, head of equity and portfolio manager at PepsiCo investor Aptus Capital Advisors. On Tuesday, Coca-Cola (KO.N) CEO Henrique Braun said pressure on consumers could extend into 2027. "We are seeing elevated cost pressures ... driven by increased logistics and transportation costs," he said as the company [USN:L3N46D109 TEXT:"raised its annual profit forecast"]. HOW HIGH CAN PRICES GO? The challenge is working out how high prices can rise before shoppers walk away. The chair of Lindt & Sprüngli (LISN.S) said the Swiss chocolate maker is struggling because it [USN:L2N46A04K TEXT:"misjudged"] how consumers would respond to price increases. He spoke days after the company [USN:L6N4650EX TEXT:"ousted its CEO"] over concerns about its performance. Companies are running out of ways to absorb costs. Consumers in Europe and North America are particularly squeezed, said Reckitt (RKT.L) CEO Kris Licht. He said companies must decide how much of the cost increase to pass on through pricing and how much to offset with more promotional spending. "We will probably have to price more at this level of commodity costs and input costs," Licht said after the Durex maker trimmed its annual revenue forecast, sending its shares down around 5% on Tuesday. Procter & Gamble (PG.N) CFO Andre Schulten expressed a similar view after the Tide detergent maker last week hiked its expected [USN:L4N46811U TEXT:"hit to profit"] from rising raw material, energy and freight costs to $1.4 billion from $1 billion. "At this level of commodity pressure ... the industry generally is pricing up because there is no way to recover this level of commodity pressure without pricing," Schulten said. Procter & Gamble's pricing and sales held steady in the last quarter, but higher costs really hurt margins, said Brian Mulberry, chief market strategist at Zacks Investment Management. "Consumers are still spending if they see the value ... but we likely are near the upper limit of what consumers are willing to pay for snacks," Mulberry said. PepsiCo (PEP.O) has swung between price rises and cuts this year in an effort to boost sluggish sales and it [USN:L6N45U0N9 TEXT:"suffered a margin hit"] last quarter. Raising prices risks losing customers. Nestle (NESN.S) CFO Anna Manz said last week that volumes can dip in the short term when the company raises prices, as consumers adjust. "Looking forward, there's now again some upward pressure on input costs," Manz said as Nestle posted faster quarterly volume growth than pricing growth [USN:L6N4680BP TEXT:"for the first time"] since 2024. "We'll take pricing to the extent we can without damaging medium-term consumer penetration," she said.

item.title: FDA warns Amgen over cancer drug promotional video
item.description: The US FDA on Tuesday warned Amgen that a promotional video for its colorectal cancer drug was misleading because it highlighted the benefits while failing to adequately disclose serious safety risks and patient limitations.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The US FDA on Tuesday warned Amgen (AMGN.O) that a promotional video for its colorectal cancer drug was misleading because it highlighted the benefits while failing to adequately disclose serious safety risks and patient limitations. Here are some details: In a warning letter dated August 12, the FDA said the video promoted the drug Vectibix as an option for adults with a type of advanced colorectal cancer and noted that infusions can take 60 minutes or less and do not require premedication The regulator said that the video contained no information on risk, despite Vectibix carrying a boxed warning for severe skin reactions The drug can also cause potentially fatal infusion reactions, lung disease, kidney failure and other serious side effects, the FDA said The regulator said the video failed to disclose which type of patients can use Vectibix, including limits tied to tumor testing "By failing to adequately communicate the full indication for Vectibix and limitations of use associated with Vectibix, the video creates a misleading impression about the drug's FDA-approved indication and use," the FDA said The regulator told Amgen to stop using misleading promotional material, submit a written response within 15 working days and propose corrective communications for the video's audience It said failure to address the issues could lead to legal action, including product seizure or an injunction

item.title: US agency approves Amazon Leo’s $11.5 billion acquisition of Globalstar
item.description: The Federal Communications Commission said Tuesday it has approved Amazon Leo’s $11.5 billion deal to acquire Globalstar as the retail giant's satellite arm aims to build a satellite-based communications network to take on Elon Musk's SpaceX Starlink unit .
item.dc:creator: David Shepardson
item.content:encoded: The Federal Communications Commission said Tuesday it has approved Amazon (AMZN.O) Leo’s $11.5 billion deal to acquire Globalstar (GSAT.O) as the retail giant's satellite arm aims to build a satellite-based communications network to take on Elon Musk's SpaceX Starlink unit (SPCX.O) . Amazon Leo has launched more than 300 satellites since April 2025 and aims to deploy about 3,200 satellites in Earth's low orbit by 2029. Through the deal, Amazon adds Globalstar's two dozen satellites to its existing network of more than 200 and its mobile-satellite spectrum. Amazon, which has committed to investing more than $10 billion in Leo, is preparing to roll out its commercial satellite services by the end of 2026, the FCC said. The FCC said the companies’ assets will boost Amazon Leo’s entry into the direct-to-device market and allow the satellite-operator to offer fixed and mobile services. "The FCC has empowered Amazon Leo to deliver fast, next-gen satellite broadband services, increase competition, and help communities stay connected all across the country," FCC Chair Brendan Carr said. Direct-to-device satellite technology allows smartphones and other devices to connect directly to satellites. Tech companies are pouring billions of dollars into capturing the lucrative market for satellite-based connectivity as they race to complete with Starlink's network of more than 11,000 satellites. The FCC will vote Thursday to advance a new auction of wireless spectrum to boost "direct-to-device" services. Globalstar currently powers satellite-based safety features such as Emergency SOS and Find My for Apple's (AAPL.O) iPhone and Apple Watch users. Amazon said earlier that it has signed an agreement with Apple to continue providing those services. Apple invested about $1.5 billion in Globalstar in 2024 to fund the expansion of its iPhone communication services, in a deal that also gave the tech giant a 20% equity in Globalstar. Apple accounted for about 63% of Globalstar revenue last year and Amazon plans to acquire Apple's stake, the FCC said. Globalstar said late last year that a new, Apple-backed network under development would expand its footprint to 54 satellites, including a small number of backups, from the two dozen currently.

item.title: Mexico's electoral body INE names interim chief after resignation over corruption
item.description: Mexico's National Electoral Institute named Blanca Cruz as its interim president on Tuesday, according to several local media reports, following the resignation of Guadalupe Taddei amid allegations of irregularities and corruption at the electoral authority.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Mexico's National Electoral Institute named Blanca Cruz as its interim president on Tuesday, according to several local media reports, following the resignation of Guadalupe Taddei amid allegations of irregularities and corruption at the electoral authority. Cruz, an electoral adviser who joined the INE's General Council in April, will lead the autonomous body until Taddei's permanent successor is named by lawmakers. Taddei [USN:L2N46C0L2 TEXT:"resigned"] on Monday, in the most high-profile departure tied to alleged corruption in President Claudia Sheinbaum's two-year-old presidency. Sheinbaum said she supported Taddei's decision. "It is a good time for whoever takes office to exercise transparency and ensure that no department within the National Electoral Institute favors any particular side, and that the Institute fulfills its duties," Sheinbaum said at her daily press conference on Tuesday. The abrupt leadership change comes as the INE prepares to oversee Mexico's 2027 midterm elections, and could risk damaging the electoral institute's credibility.

item.title: Connor Hellebuyck to make Devils' debut vs. Stars
item.description: Connor Hellebuyck will make his debut with the New Jersey Devils on Tuesday when he starts against the Dallas Stars, head coach Sheldon Keefe announced.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Connor Hellebuyck will make his debut with the New Jersey Devils on Tuesday when he starts against the Dallas Stars, head coach Sheldon Keefe announced. The Devils acquired the star goaltender from the Winnipeg Jets last Friday, the same day his suspension for failing to report to training camp ended. Hellebuyck, 33, is a three-time Vezina Trophy winner as the NHL's top goalie and 2025 Hart Trophy recipient as the league MVP. He has not played in an NHL game since April 13. Hellebuyck was the star of the U.S. Olympic team that won the gold medal at the 2026 Winter Games in Milan Cortina. He made 41 saves as the U.S. beat Canada 2-1 in overtime in the final. Hellebuyck had a down season by his standards in 2025-26, finishing 23-23-11 with a 2.86 goals-against average and a career-worst .895 save percentage. Winnipeg failed to make the playoffs, going 35-35-12. In 625 career NHL games, Hellebuyck has a 345-208-55 record with 45 shutouts, a 2.58 GAA and a .916 save percentage. --Field Level Media

item.title: Bengals place TE Erick All Jr. (knee) on IR
item.description: The Cincinnati Bengals placed Erick All Jr. on injured reserve and signed fellow tight end Cam Grandy off the Minnesota Vikings' practice squad on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Cincinnati Bengals placed Erick All Jr. on injured reserve and signed fellow tight end Cam Grandy off the Minnesota Vikings' practice squad on Tuesday. All, 26, sustained a knee injury during Sunday's 35-13 win at Baltimore. NFL Network reported the injury is believed to be a torn ACL. He missed the last seven games of his 2024 rookie season and the entire 2025 campaign with the same injury. All caught eight passes for 56 yards in six games (one start) this season. He has 28 catches for 214 yards and no touchdowns in 15 games (seven starts) since Cincinnati drafted him in the fourth round in 2024. Grandy, 25, rejoins the Bengals, who signed him as an undrafted free agent in 2024 and waived him following training camp this summer. He played in 13 games (seven starts) for Cincinnati from 2024-25, catching seven passes for 35 yards. Cincinnati also signed Caden Prieskorn to the practice squad and placed fellow tight end Josh Kattus on the practice squad injured list. --Field Level Media

item.title: Shopee eleva capacidade em 60% em um ano e aguarda Anvisa para venda de medicamentos
item.description: A Shopee disse nesta terça-feira que abriu mais quatro centros de distribuição no Brasil, consolidando um movimento de expansão logística que aumentou sua capacidade de processamento de pedidos em 60% no último ano.
item.dc:creator: Andre Romani
item.content:encoded: A Shopee disse nesta terça-feira que abriu mais quatro centros de distribuição no Brasil, consolidando um movimento de expansão logística que aumentou sua capacidade de processamento de pedidos em 60% no último ano. A plataforma de comércio eletrônico, da empresa de Cingapura Sea (SE.N) , inaugurou centros de distribuição em Recife, Rio de Janeiro, Vitória e Blumenau (SC), enquanto triplicou a área operacional de seu centro em Piracicaba (SP). As inaugurações levam o total de centros de distribuição da Shopee no Brasil a 30, contra 16 há um ano. São 25 unidades no modelo de passagem "cross-docking", incluindo as quatro novas e o complexo em Piracicaba, e cinco centros "fulfillment", em que a companhia também estoca produtos de vendedores. A Shopee entrou no Brasil em 2020 e, atualmente, é uma das principais empresas de comércio eletrônico no Brasil, disputando o mercado principalmente com Amazon (AMZN.O) e Mercado Livre (MELI.O) . A companhia afirma ter mais de 3 milhões de vendedores locais em sua plataforma. A companhia disse que as novas quatro unidades, mais a expansão em Piracicaba, adicionaram capacidade de processamento de 2,4 milhões de pedidos por dia. A empresa não diz qual é sua capacidade total em produtos no Brasil. Mas, para base de comparação, afirma que vendeu mais de 20 milhões de itens no último 11 de novembro, o 11/11, principal data promocional da companhia no país, acima inclusive da Black Friday. Para este ano, a Shopee disse que prepara R$25 milhões em cupons de desconto no 11/11, contra R$20 milhões no ano passado, e R$23 milhões para a sexta-feira de Black Friday, versus R$16 milhões em 2025. "Estamos muito focados em crescer nossa capacidade agora para atender esse aumento expressivo de demanda do final do ano", disse o diretor de logística e estratégia da Shopee, Tiago Freddi, durante evento da empresa em seu centro de distribuição em Franco da Rocha (SP). REGULAÇÃO SOBRE MEDICAMENTOS A Shopee vai esperar a conclusão de regulamentação pela Anvisa antes de potencialmente liberar farmácias para venderem medicamentos em sua plataforma, disse o diretor de desenvolvimento de negócios e operações de fulfillment, Felipe Lima. "A gente tem acompanhado muito a regulamentação, inclusive, em discussões com a Anvisa, e nós entendemos que a gente precisa ainda ter mais clareza quanto a essa legislação antes de fazer algum movimento," disse. O Mercado Livre [USN:L1N45Z11G TEXT:"iniciou no último mês"] a venda de medicamentos no país, tanto por sua farmácia própria quanto por farmácias terceiras. Uma lei aprovada pelo Congresso e sancionada neste ano autorizou a venda de medicamentos em marketplaces. A Anvisa, porém, ainda prepara uma regulamentação própria sobre o assunto. No caso da Shopee, que não tem uma operação própria de varejo -- o chamado 1P --, a eventual venda de remédios seria apenas por meio de farmácias terceiras, disse Felipe Piringer, diretor de marketing. Atualmente, mais de 40 redes de farmácias já vendem outros produtos, como cosméticos, na Shopee. Lima disse que o entendimento da Shopee é de que os medicamentos precisarão ser direcionados diretamente da farmácia ao consumidor, o que a empresa poderia atender através de sua [USN:L6N44A0UC TEXT:"operação Turbo"], lançada em agosto em São Paulo e que promete entregas em até 4 horas.

item.title: FIFA visitará en noviembre y diciembre las posibles ciudades sede del Mundial de 2030
item.description: La FIFA dijo el martes que llevará a cabo una serie de visitas a las ciudades candidatas de España, Portugal y Marruecos en noviembre y diciembre, como parte del proceso de selección de sedes para el Mundial 2030.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La FIFA dijo el martes que llevará a cabo una serie de visitas a las ciudades candidatas de España, Portugal y Marruecos en noviembre y diciembre, como parte del proceso de selección de sedes para el Mundial 2030. Una delegación de la FIFA visitará las ciudades candidatas y los estadios de los tres países anfitriones para evaluar su idoneidad para acoger los partidos. La FIFA aún no ha confirmado qué sedes se incluirán, ni ha anunciado dónde se celebrará la final del Mundial, por lo que España y Marruecos compiten por acoger el partido más importante del torneo. Se han programado visitas a Agadir, Casablanca, Fez, Marrakech, Rabat y Tánger, en Marruecos; Lisboa y Oporto, en Portugal; y Barcelona, Bilbao, Las Palmas, Madrid, San Sebastián, Sevilla y Zaragoza, en España. La FIFA ha indicado que también podría realizar visitas a otras sedes durante el proceso de selección. Añadió que la asignación de los partidos y el tipo de encuentros que se disputarán en cada sede se determinarán una vez que se haya confirmado la lista definitiva de ciudades anfitrionas y avance la elaboración del calendario del torneo. Los tres primeros partidos del Mundial 2030 se disputarán en Argentina, Uruguay y Paraguay, en homenaje al centenario de la competición, que se celebró por primera vez en 1930 en Uruguay.

item.title: Cómico británico Brand aseguró en el juicio que nunca mantuvo relaciones sexuales sin consentimiento
item.description: El cómico y actor británico Russell Brand declaró ante la policía que nunca había mantenido relaciones sexuales no consentidas, a pesar de haber tenido encuentros en innumerables lugares y situaciones, según se informó el martes en un tribunal de Londres.
item.dc:creator: Michael Holden
item.content:encoded: El cómico y actor británico Russell Brand declaró ante la policía que nunca había mantenido relaciones sexuales no consentidas, a pesar de haber tenido encuentros en innumerables lugares y situaciones, según se informó el martes en un tribunal de Londres. Brand, que en su día fue uno de los presentadores más destacados de Gran Bretaña y exmarido de la cantante estadounidense Katy Perry, está siendo juzgado en el Tribunal Penal de Southwark, en Londres, por acusaciones de delitos sexuales contra seis mujeres entre 1999 y 2009. El hombre, de 51 años, ha negado todas las acusaciones. BRAND ABSUELTO DE UN CARGO, SE LE IMPUTA OTRO Se le imputan tres cargos de violación y tres de agresión sexual y, el martes, el juez ordenó al jurado que dictara un veredicto de "no culpable" respecto a una acusación de abuso sexual. Sin embargo, ahora se enfrentará a un nuevo cargo de intento de abuso sexual por ese supuesto incidente. Anteriormente se había explicado al jurado cómo todas las mujeres se presentaron ante los detectives tras la emisión de un documental en 2023, junto con una serie de artículos periodísticos sobre él. La fiscalía ha expuesto sus argumentos según los cuales Brand era un depredador despiadado y se espera que el excomediante exponga su defensa el miércoles. Pero el martes se dieron a conocer por primera vez ante el tribunal sus respuestas a las acusaciones. Los fiscales leyeron las declaraciones preparadas que Brand proporcionó a la policía durante cuatro entrevistas celebradas entre septiembre de 2023 y julio de 2025 a raíz de las acusaciones. En estas declaraciones, afirmó que el documental y los reportajes periodísticos "difamatorios y ficticios", que contenían "acusaciones falsas y anónimas" contra él, habían llevado a los medios de comunicación y a la policía a recabar otras acusaciones en su contra. Esto, según él, había allanado el camino para que "se inventaran o se reimaginaran nuevos incidentes". "Nunca he participado en ninguna actividad sexual no consentida", decía su declaración. Afirmó que había declarado en repetidas ocasiones que en el pasado había tenido una vida sexual muy promiscua, un comportamiento que ahora condenaba. Dijo que había mantenido relaciones sexuales en los baños de las fiestas y que había tenido encuentros sexuales en "innumerables lugares y situaciones, a menudo con personas que acababa de conocer". "Esos encuentros siempre fueron consentidos", afirmó. El jurado ha escuchado acusaciones de que Brand violó a una mujer tras conocerla en un acto paralelo a la conferencia del Partido Laborista en 1999, obligó a una mujer a practicarle sexo oral en los baños de un bar londinense en 2004 y había acosado sexualmente a otra mujer en una emisora de radio en 2004 ó 2005. También se le acusa de intentar arrastrar a una mujer al baño de hombres de MTV Europe, en Londres, donde ella trabajaba en 2001, y de violar analmente a una mujer que había accedido a mantener relaciones sexuales consentidas en su domicilio en 2009. La última acusación es que agredió a una mujer que trabajaba en la cadena de televisión Channel 4, donde ambos participaban en un proyecto de grabación.

item.title: Publicaciones engañosas omiten saludo entre Zelenski y el rey de Suecia
item.description: Un clip de un encuentro en abril entre el rey de Suecia, Carlos XVI Gustavo, y el presidente de Ucrania, Volodímir Zelenski, fue compartido de forma engañosa en redes sociales para decir que el monarca se negó a estrechar la mano del mandatario.
item.dc:creator: Reuters Fact Check
item.content:encoded: Un clip de un encuentro en abril entre el rey de Suecia, Carlos XVI Gustavo, y el presidente de Ucrania, Volodímir Zelenski, fue compartido de forma engañosa en redes sociales para decir que el monarca se negó a estrechar la mano del mandatario. Estos son los detalles clave: El clip fue grabado durante la visita del rey de Suecia a Leópolis, Ucrania, el 17 de abril de 2026. Muestra al rey descender de su vehículo y posar con Zelenski para fotografías. La cadena pública ucraniana Suspilne Novyny compartió una versión más larga del video, que muestra al segundo 00:25 cómo ambos se estrechan la mano. Una fotografía de la Oficina de la Presidencia de Ucrania y un video de Reuters también capturaron el saludo. En un correo del 27 de octubre, la Corte Real de Suecia dijo que el rey y Zelenski se dieron la mano en varias ocasiones. Remitió a una publicación del 26 de octubre del primer ministro sueco, Ulf Kristersson, en la que se refirió al video y expresó su apoyo a Ucrania. La ministra de Asuntos Exteriores de Suecia, Maria Malmer Stenergard, quien acompañó al rey durante la visita, también dijo en una publicación del 17 de abril que el rey y Zelenski se estrecharon la mano. La página de la Corte Real de Suecia no registra visitas del rey a Ucrania en octubre. Veredicto: Engañoso. El rey de Suecia y Zelenski se estrecharon la mano durante su encuentro en Leópolis en abril. Reuters Fact Check ofrece información confiable mediante su canal de WhatsApp para México .
